I studied psychology and education and spent years working in the nonprofit and education sectors, thinking that would be my life’s work.

But when I discovered growth, sales, and startups, something clicked.

Sales is about people.

If you're a founder, growth leader, or someone just figuring it out, I’d love to connect.

In short, I grow B2B businesses with little known growth marketing tactics. 

It's taken years of trial & error -- but on my journey I've learned the difference between "doing marketing" for marketing's sake versus driving results in the form of cold hard cash collected.

At 17 I started my first agency while still in high school 

I was helping local businesses with things like social media content, ads, websites etc..

Things were going well - but I yearned to work on more ambitious projects.

-> I tried my hand at a consumer social app startup
-> I interned at the 5th largest marketing agency in the healthcare space
-> I became the marketing lead at a venture backed AI startup in silicon valley

On my journey I was shocked to discover that most agencies, "marketers", and startups know very little about marketing. 

-> Their feeds were filled with generic posts pitching their products and services
-> Their outreach campaigns were obviously automated and uninspiring
->  They would show the "leads" they generated but could never connect their actions directly to revenue generated

I got back into the agency game to help companies with great products/services scale rapidly through any channel necessary.

Some of the most effective tactics we're currently utilizing include:

-> Content Marketing Funnels on Linkedin, X, and Youtube
-> High Volume Cold Email Campaigns personalized with AI
-> Manual LinkedIn outreach
-> Building personal brands and driving inbound leads with founder led content

and much more as the landscape seemingly evolves by the day in 2025
